products.text:
Type: upholstered wingback dining chair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, mid-century modern
Materials: textured woven tweed upholstery, bronze-finish metal sled base
Colors: dark charcoal grey flecked tweed, warm bronze
Shape: winged back that narrows to the seat, armless, padded seat, U-shaped sled legs, sturdy and medium weight
Feel: cozy, refined, grounded
Goes with: dark wood or marble tables, brass accents, warm neutrals; modern or contemporary dining rooms

Type: velvet dining chair, set of two
Use: dining, sitting at a vanity or desk; dining room, home office
Style: mid-century modern, glam, contemporary
Materials: soft velvet upholstery, gold-finish metal legs
Colors: dark forest green, shiny gold
Shape: armless one-piece shell with curved back and waist cutouts, padded seat, four slim splayed legs, light and compact
Feel: luxe, elegant, rich
Goes with: marble or white tables, brass accents, blush or cream walls; glam or mid-century rooms

Type: wooden dining armchair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, home office
Style: mid-century modern, traditional, rustic
Materials: stained solid wood frame, woven paper cord seat
Colors: warm medium brown wood, natural beige seat
Shape: horizontal slatted ladder back, open arms, woven seat, gently curved shaped legs, medium weight
Feel: warm, crafted, inviting
Goes with: walnut or oak tables, cream walls, woven textures; mid-century or traditional dining rooms

Type: cane dining armchair
Use: dining, reading corner seating; dining room, living room
Style: coastal, bohemian, traditional
Materials: solid light wood frame, woven rattan cane back, sides and seat
Colors: light warm natural wood, honey cane
Shape: cane panel back, curved sloping arms with cane sides, cane seat, slightly curved legs, open and airy, medium size
Feel: breezy, warm, relaxed
Goes with: light wood or white tables, linen, green plants; coastal, boho or Scandinavian rooms
